name: USGS Water Services
tagline: Real-time and historical streamflow, groundwater, and water quality data from the U.S. Geological Survey.
description: USGS Water Services provides free public REST APIs for real-time and historical hydrologic data, including streamflow, groundwater levels, water quality, and site metadata. Core services include Instantaneous Values (IV), Daily Values (DV), Site Service, and Groundwater Levels, with JSON, WaterML, and RDB formats. No API key is required for standard public access; rate limits apply for fair use. Data covers thousands of monitoring stations across the United States.

auth.details: No authentication required for public access. Requests are unauthenticated HTTPS GETs; no API key, OAuth, or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public service; no paid plans. Fair-use rate limits apply (see rate_limits).

rate_limits: For small requests (e.g. up to 7–14 days for a single site): max 5–10 requests/sec steady; brief bursts of 40–50 requests/sec OK but not sustained. Excessive use may be blocked (HTTP 403).
